newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management says to acquire Reserve.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management says to acquire Reserve.

text.p: Metal Management Inc, a consolidator in the scrap metal industry, said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire all the partnership interests in Reserve Iron & Metal LP, of Cleveland, Ohio.
The $34-million transaction consists of payment of cash, short-term promissory notes in the amount of about $1.6 million and assumption of Reserve's bank debt, Metal said.

Reserve, with 1996 revenues of $110 million, is a scrap metal recycling company with additional operations in Illinois and Alabama. The transaction will bring Metal Management's revenues to an annualized rate of about $225 million, it said.
Reserve will become a wholly-owned unit of Metal Management, it said.
